data.reason_zh: 提出EVISKILL，将执行观察整理为证据卡，通过重放反馈修正技能编辑并跨轮保留，属于持续技能自改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction.
scope_support.object_quote: organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts
scope_support.persistence_quote: Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill.
